author: Shardhash
text:
Sharden: A mineable coin for paying miners I built Sharden as an autonomous mineable PoW cryptocurrency on Ethereum blockchain which also has an interesting potential use case for miners themselves as a payment method.

Miners can mine SHARDEN themselves, trade it on crypto markets where it can acquire a market price, and then use SHARDEN as an additional payment method when mining other cryptocurrencies.
